svg.title: Multi-View Spacecraft Engineering Blueprint
svg.desc: Professional aerospace schematic with top, side, front, rear, and cutaway views of a reusable orbital spacecraft.
svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT / SYSTEMS CUTAWAY / ORTHOGRAPHIC REFERENCE

g.text: SCALE 1:100 • DATUM CL ON VEHICLE LONGITUDINAL AXIS
GEAR SHOWN DEPLOYED • SOLAR ARRAYS SHOWN STOWED IN SIDE PROJECTION
PORT HALF REMOVED • PRIMARY STRUCTURE / PROPULSION / HABITABILITY SYSTEMS
PRIMARY PRESSURE HULL: Al-Li ISOGRID, 6.0 m MAX DIA.
MAIN PROPULSION: 4 × LOX/CH₄ VACUUM ENGINES, GIMBALED.
POWER: 2 × DEPLOYABLE SOLAR WINGS; 86 m² TOTAL ACTIVE AREA.
THERMAL: DUAL-PHASE PUMPED LOOP + 2 × DEPLOYABLE RADIATORS.
ECLSS: 6 CREW / 21 DAY NOMINAL CLOSED-LOOP HABITABILITY.
LANDING GEAR: 3-POINT RETRACTABLE, 1.8 g LIMIT LOAD.
ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm UNLESS NOTED.
DO NOT SCALE DRAWING. CONCEPTUAL ENGINEERING SCHEMATIC.
MISSION CLASS: CREW / CARGO / CISLUNAR LOGISTICS
GEOMETRIC BASELINE: L = 28.0 m / D = 6.0 m
